v0.1.0-alpha.1: The first web alpha introduces compact collection browsing, cover tiles and an inspector for media collections.
v0.1.0-alpha.2: Expanded collection management brings richer bulk actions, music presentation, calendar and folder tools, and export and sync foundations.
v0.1.0-alpha.3: Grading metadata and series completeness now carry through storage, editing, bulk operations, imports and collection displays.
v0.1.0-alpha.4: A broader library refresh improves editor workflows, reorganizes the inspector and adds inline metadata editing and image ordering.
v0.1.0: Comic inspection and metadata views receive workflow refinements. The release pipeline also publishes the web application image to GHCR.
v0.1.1: Release preparation updates the application version and publication workflow.
v0.1.2: Release packaging and job conditions are corrected to make publication more dependable.
v0.1.3: Windows packaging and asset-upload corrections allow cross-platform releases to finish publishing.
v0.1.4: Side-by-side metadata comparisons and richer relation editors improve catalog correction workflows.
v0.2.0: Collection activity gains filtering and a broader timeline. Folder-tree and shelf browsing add more ways to navigate a library.
v1.0.0: The stable Music baseline organizes albums, discs, tracks and credits. Core search, barcode lookup and catalog corrections keep shared metadata separate from personal collection data.
v1.1.0: New sorting, capitalization and localization settings give more control over library presentation. Albums also receive automatic sort titles when adding, editing and importing.
v1.2.0: Regular-expression searches highlight matching tracks and explain invalid expressions. Automatic backups and restore controls improve protection for desktop and mobile libraries.
v1.3.0: Games, Hardware and Toys gain dedicated libraries, editors and Core search. Guided CLZ import and XML and CSV/TXT workflows expand collection portability.
v1.4.0: Adding Games gains clearer platform and edition selection, cover browsing and region filters. Online cover search, value links and rich-text descriptions improve everyday collection work, while export and asynchronous action fixes reduce interruptions.

v1.5.0.headline: Comics arrive
v1.5.0.summary: Collectarr App adds the Comics library, with CLZ Comics Web, Comic Collector XML and CSV import and typed Add and Edit forms. Working with Core is reworked: Compare with Core shows your values beside Core's, Propose to Core sends only the fields you changed, unlinked entries can be submitted to Core as new items, and administrators review proposals in the Admin Proposals tab. Covers linked from other sites are downloaded after an import and kept offline, and many screens now follow the reference more closely. Collectarr App is now licensed under AGPL-3.0-only.
